name: Orderful
summary: A light industrial command-deck style with matte vellum canvas, white cards, universal 8px geometry, telegraf typography, sparse shadows, and one vermillion action signal.

vermillionSignal.role: Primary action fill, selected conversion moments, connector nodes

inkBlack.role: Hairline borders, logo marks, high-contrast icon strokes

carbon.role: Dark product UI panels, inverted feature panels, footer surface

slate700.role: Navigation text, active nav items, secondary headings

slate600.role: Body copy, subtext, icon strokes, eyebrow labels

steel.role: Subdued heading text and testimonial attributions

iron.role: Tertiary helper text and decorative dividers

mist.role: Icon borders, muted labels, disabled states

cloud.role: Button borders, input borders, section dividers

frost.role: Card hairline borders and subtle container edges

paper.role: Card surfaces, button text on dark fills, content canvas

vellum.role: Primary page canvas and matte-paper background

elevation.guidance: Use sparingly; most separation should come from borders, surfaces, and spacing.

components.vermillionFilledActionButton: Primary CTA with #e42b0c background, white uppercase text, 8px radius, and trailing arrow.
components.sunsetGradientNavButton: Top-nav-only conversion button with Sunset Flux gradient and white uppercase text.
components.carbonDarkActionButton: Secondary read-next action with Carbon background, white text, and 8px radius.
components.outlinedNavPill: Eyebrow or current-page indicator with 1px Cloud border, transparent fill, 8px radius, uppercase 12px label.
components.featureCard: White card with 8px radius, 1px Frost border, 32px padding, icon, heading, body, and muted link.
components.heroProductVisualTile: White product tile containing dark inner panels, vermillion connector nodes, and retailer brand grid.
components.testimonialCard: White quote card with 40px padding, thin pull quote, headshot, and metric row.
components.statBlock: 60px thin metric number with 14px muted label, no card chrome.
components.logoStrip: White trust band with grayscale logos arranged like a printed masthead.
components.navigationBar: Sticky white 64px nav with Frost divider, uppercase nav items, ghost login, and gradient CTA.
components.chatWidget: Bottom-right white floating card with vermillion avatar and mini-CTA chips.
components.textInputField: White input with Cloud border, 8px radius, 48px height, and no glow.

dos: Use Vermillion only for filled primary actions and conversion signals.
Set display headlines at 48px to 72px with tight negative tracking.
Apply 8px radius uniformly across core UI.
Keep shadows to a small two-layer stack.
Use Slate 900 for display and heading text.
Use 16px to 18px body text with 1.5 line height.
donts: Do not use 4px, 6px, 12px, or pill radii for core UI.
Do not set display text in weight 700.
Do not use Vermillion on non-action decorative surfaces.
Do not use body text below 14px.
Do not introduce a second saturated color.
Do not use letter-spacing values outside the defined range.
Do not place Carbon cards on Paper without clear emphasis reason.
